question: What is on My binome?
answer: Your candidates, where each one stands, the alerts the script raised on them and a link to your binome sheet. It reads the same cells as your sheet: what you fill in here is what the sheet shows.

question: What can View and Edit do?
answer: With Edit access to your binome sheet you fill in the gold fields (contacted, interview day and time, done, rating, affectation, notes) and the interview form, here or in the sheet. View is read-only, and so is a cover. The admins set your binome's access.

question: When do I see my partner's changes?
answer: What one partner saves shows on the other's screen at their next refresh. The page refreshes by itself while it is open.

question: What does Needs you list?
answer: The open alerts on your candidates, worst first: anyone not contacted, not scheduled or overdue. The script checks your candidates on every sync, and an alert goes away once the sheet shows it is handled.

question: How do I fill the interview form here?
answer: On My binome, Fill interview form opens the candidate's own page. Their 1st choice starts on the registration's value and picks the department section, and a bar counts the required answers. A draft is kept in this browser until you submit. After that the button says Edit answers, and you can change them any time; if your partner saved meanwhile, their version loads and your draft is kept. View-only members and covers get the Google Form, prefilled with both codes.

question: What happens after I submit?
answer: At the next sync the answers reach the Interview Log and the candidate becomes Interviewed. The form also fills Rating (the average of the scores) and Final Affectation when they are empty. A value you typed by hand in the sheet stays.

question: Why does it say my binome isn't open yet?
answer: The admins share each binome's sheet at launch, and My binome opens only while you can open your binome sheet. The page checks again every 15 seconds and fills itself as soon as your binome is ready.

question: How long does a sign-in last?
answer: 48 hours. Signing back in within that window skips the permission screen. Use your @g.enp.edu.dz account.
